description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior ML Engineer based in United States. 

 We are seeking an experienced Machine Learning Engineer to contribute to an advanced AI training project focused on developing, improving, and validating machine-learning systems. In this flexible, fully remote contractor role, you will apply your technical expertise to challenging engineering tasks involving model development, training pipelines, inference systems, numerical computing, and performance optimization. You will help create and assess complex solutions, build reproducible workflows, and ensure implementations meet measurable standards for correctness and efficiency. Working independently with Python and modern coding agents, you will have the opportunity to contribute to impactful AI initiatives while choosing when and where you work. This opportunity is particularly suited to specialists who enjoy solving complex technical problems and delivering high-quality engineering outcomes.



Accountabilities
 

 
 Develop, implement, and validate machine-learning models, training pipelines, inference systems, and supporting infrastructure.



 
 Build and improve model components, data pipelines, evaluation frameworks, and numerical computing methods.



 
 Create reproducible programmatic workflows using Python and command-line tools.



 
 Design, solve, review, and validate challenging machine-learning engineering tasks, ensuring solutions meet defined technical and performance requirements.



 
 Optimize model performance, memory usage, throughput, and computational efficiency.



 
 Investigate and resolve numerical, software, and system-level issues affecting model training or inference.



 
 Assess implementations for correctness, reliability, reproducibility, and alignment with project specifications.




 Requirements:


 
 BSc, MSc, or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a closely related quantitative discipline.



 
 Strong professional or research experience in machine learning and practical ML engineering.



 
 Advanced Python programming skills and hands-on experience using coding agents.



 
 Demonstrated expertise in at least one of the following areas: inference and serving, model evaluation, data and feature engineering, retrieval/ranking/RAG, MLOps, model compression and optimization, or GPU/kernel optimization.



 
 Ability to develop, debug, and assess complex technical implementations independently.



 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to technical accuracy and measurable outcomes.



 
 Experience in a recognized technology company, AI laboratory, research organization, or established engineering environment is highly desirable.



 
 Exceptional academic contributions or open-source engineering experience may also be considered.



 
 Availability to begin promptly, with the ability to start the first task within 24–48 hours after completing onboarding if selected.




 Benefits:


 
 Competitive hourly compensation ranging from $60 to $120, depending on expertise and project requirements.



 
 Fully remote contractor opportunity, open to candidates globally.



 
 Flexible working arrangements, with the freedom to choose your working hours and days, including weekends.



 
 Part-time commitment of approximately 15 hours per week.



 
 Output-based compensation: payment is provided for tasks that meet the established project specifications, with task duration varying according to complexity and individual workflow.



 
 Opportunity to work on advanced AI training initiatives and challenging machine-learning engineering problems.



 
 Potential for a fast hiring process, with roles typically filled within approximately 48 hours.



 
 Opportunity to contribute independently while applying specialized technical knowledge to impactful AI development work.






How Jobgether works:
We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!
 Why Apply Through Jobgether? 
 
Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.
